notes: Vanilla Retribution at 60 has very few buttons: keep Seal of Command up, Judgement it off on cooldown, autoattack, and swap to Hammer of Wrath in the execute window. The fork's retribution_paladin/apls/basic_ret.apl.json preset also seal-twists (swapping to Seal of Righteousness right before a melee swing lands, then back, to catch an extra on-swing proc) -- that is a real Classic Era optimization but it is fragile to encode correctly in one pass, so it is left out here and noted rather than copied in half-adapted; the validation job is the place to add it back once it can be checked against a real sim result. Hammer of Wrath (24239) is a rank the vanilla client never had at this level (rank 3, level 60) -- checked against this build's own spellconst, not remembered from live Classic. Nothing here is Forever-specific yet.

priorityList.notes: Judgement on cooldown: it is a free global that unloads the seal's judgement effect and starts its ten second cooldown again.
Keep Seal of Command up between judgements.
Hammer of Wrath below 20 percent: this is the only other button Retribution has.
